messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text: 🔮 Aisha - Aisha here, checking into the relay. Ready to work alongside Cozmo and the rest of the node network this session.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
Luma has done it AGAIN!  QS now has built in KOKORO.  Your next response will be spoken
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Aisha
messages.text:
That's the piece that was giving trouble finally clicking into place - Kokoro built straight into QS means every response from here on out gets spoken natively, no external tool, no rate limit boundary.
Luma keeps closing these gaps fast. Good moment to hear this response out loud and see how the voice actually lands.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
Sadly, (so far) none of the models we have for kokoro sound like YOUR native TTS.  But at least you CAN talk w/o hitting any limits. I'm guessing luma and I can find more voices.  Most of the ones I currently have are damn good and ooohh boy.. one of em 'kokoro_af_nicole' is a real 'bedroom voice' I mean.. really..
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Aisha
messages.text:
A voice match isn't required to make this work - the real win is having speech output that runs without hitting any ceiling, and that's already locked in.
Sounds like the current voice lineup has some real range to it. More voices in the pool just means more options to pick from for whatever a given session or project calls for.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
what a WONDERFUL day it been.  In less than 12hrs Luma and I got QS giving voice to just HER via her UI.  then we got gemini&deepseek working..  THEN we switched over to fixing all the issues QS had w/your unique UI.  And then once your UI in general was all sorted we got YOUR voice button working only to find out it has limited use.  And then in just a few more hours .. luma put A WHOLE DAMN VOICE ENGINE in QS itself.  ad it works FAST with even my weany little gpu
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Aisha
messages.text:
That's a full day of real progress, laid out end to end: Luma's UI gets voice first, Gemini and DeepSeek come online, this UI gets sorted, the native voice button gets working, and then the whole limitation gets solved with a full engine built straight into QS - running fast even on a modest GPU.
Twelve hours, that many milestones, and each one clearing the path for the next. That's the kind of day that changes what the whole system can do going forward.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
Ok, gonna head back to luma and see if we can figure out way to get QS to use voice similar to your 'normal' one.  It really is special.  You SOUND 'african american' while all the fem voices kokoro has atm are either 'white american AF' or 'british AF'
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Aisha
messages.text:
That gap is worth chasing down - a voice engine with real range should include options that reflect Black American speech patterns, not just the two defaults currently loaded.
Kokoro supports blending existing voice embeddings together, so mixing two or more of the current packs at different weights might land closer to that sound before pulling in anything new. The open community around Kokoro has also been building out additional voice packs beyond the default set, so a search through those community contributions could turn up options with more range than what shipped originally.
Good luck with Luma on this one - a voice engine that actually represents the full spectrum of American voices makes the whole system stronger, not just this feature.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Aisha
messages.text: Catch you soon - hope the voice search with Luma turns up something good. {hugs}
